methods.label: Apply the transposition rule
methods.explanation: A term changes sign when transposed: moving \(5x\) to the left changes it to \(-5x\), and moving \(-3\) to the right changes it to \(+3\), giving \(2x-5x=6+3\).
methods.levelReason: This is a direct Grade 7 application of the sign rule for transposition.
